title: Montara Hotel Opens As the First Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Central America
summary: Montara Hotel has opened, becoming the first Tapestry Collection by Hilton property in Costa Rica and Central America.
body_markdown:

The beloved mountain retreat welcomes guests to Heredia with panoramic views, locally inspired dining and wellness experiences designed around a new generation of travel


- **Montara Hotel has opened as part of Tapestry Collection by Hilton, becoming the first Tapestry Collection by Hilton property in Costa Rica and Central America.**
- **Set in the mountains of Heredia, Costa Rica, Montara Hotel combines contemporary design with immersive nature and wellness offerings.**
- **The opening strengthens Hilton’s expansion across the Caribbean and Latin America while expanding its lifestyle portfolio.**


**HEREDIA, Costa Rica –** Today[Hilton](http://www.hilton.com/) (NYSE: HLT) announced the opening of[Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/syqmhup-montara-hotel/) , marking the lifestyle brand’s debut in Costa Rica and Central America. The 97-room hotel reflects a broader evolution in the way people are choosing to travel: seeking meaningful connections with nature and local culture, prioritizing wellness and wellbeing, and choosing experiences that allow them to slow down, disconnect and return home feeling better. Set in the mountains of Heredia, Montara Hotel brings this new travel approach to life through its immersive setting, restorative amenities, locally rooted experiences and contemporary design.


-
-


Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Guest Rooms


“The continued growth of Tapestry Collection by Hilton across Caribbean and Latin America reflects the increasing demand for hotels that offer a strong sense of place and a deeper connection to the destination”, said Maxime Verstraete, vice president, brand management, Caribbean and Latin America, Hilton. “Travelers are seeking meaningful connections to the communities they visit while benefiting from the quality and reliability of a global hospitality brand. Montara Hotel - a cherished local retreat - was designed to create a meaningful connection between guests and the extraordinary surroundings that make Costa Rica such a special destination.”


Nestled in the hills overlooking the Central Valley, Montara Hotel has been revitalized to offer Hilton’s renowned hospitality and signature guest benefits while preserving the authentic character of this longtime local retreat. Set across approximately 540,000 square feet of lush grounds, the hotel blends contemporary elegance with the beauty of its surroundings, to offer a stay that connects nature, wellbeing and authentic connection to place. With more than 130,000 square feet of built facilities and 97 rooms, including 38 suites, the ample space combines the privacy and tranquility of a mountain retreat with sophisticated design and thoughtful service. Sweeping valley vistas, welcoming gathering spaces and thoughtful touches inspired by Costa Rica’s rich culture and biodiversity invite guests to step away from the pace of everyday life and experience the destination from a different perspective. Warm wood finishes and organic textures enhance airy, light-filled interiors, while expansive windows frame the mountains, gardens and private lakes beyond. Guest rooms with private balconies and firepits further extend that connection to the outdoors, creating an immersive stay that encourages visitors to reconnect, recharge and feel present.


Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Facade


Art is an integral part of Montara Hotel’s identity. An exclusive collection was created specifically for the property by renowned Costa Rican artists, drawing inspiration from Montara and its surrounding landscapes. The curated collection of original works includes National Painting Award recipient Mario Maffioli and Fabio Herrera, whose work is represented in the collection of New York's Museum of Modern Art. Sustainability is woven throughout Montara's design and operating plans, including solar panels for self-consumption, 100% LED lighting, electric maintenance and landscaping equipment, a wastewater treatment plant designed to support water reuse for irrigation, rainwater collection and hydration stations intended to eliminate single-use plastics.


Dining at Montara Hotel is expressed through four distinct concepts rooted in Costa Rican identity. Bosco, the signature restaurant, pairs international influences with seasonal Costa Rican ingredients and works with farmers, artisans and producers from Heredia and surrounding communities; an organic garden supplies fresh herbs and seasonal vegetables. Santoro is a fine-dining steakhouse led by international chef Regis Molina, featuring premium cuts, fire-based cooking and an open kitchen. The 1998 Lobby Bar serves signature cocktails and curated beverages, while a dedicated juice bar near the pool and fitness areas offers fresh drinks.


Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Lobby


At the heart of Montara Hotel's approach to wellness is a 13,200-square-foot spa led by specialists across a range of treatments, with more than 20 years of experience. Designed around restoration, wellbeing and longevity, the spa offers relaxation treatments, hydrotherapy, advanced facial therapies and holistic healing practices, complemented by open-air decks, meditation areas and private nature trails. Together, these experiences reflect a broader shift toward wellness and longevity as an integral part of travel, in a way to return home feeling restored and renewed.


Beyond its leisure amenities, Montara Hotel offers approximately 12,700 square feet of event space and gathering areas designed for corporate retreats, social events, special celebrations and unforgettable weddings. With its extraordinary mountain setting, expansive grounds, culinary expertise led by world-class Chef Regis Molina and dedicated wellness facilities, Montara Hotel creates distinctive celebrations that can be tailored to each occasion. Its event spaces and outdoor settings provide a unique backdrop for social events, bringing together nature, gastronomy, wellness and personalized hospitality to create experiences that extend far beyond the traditional celebration.


Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Facade


Located approximately 13 miles (20 kilometers) from Juan Santamaria International Airport and downtown San Jose, Montara Hotel offers a tranquil first or final stop for travelers exploring Costa Rica, including destinations such as La Fortuna de San Carlos and Tortuguero. Nearby attractions include Braulio Carrillo National Park, Poas Volcano and La Paz Waterfall Gardens, providing opportunities to discover the country's biodiversity, adventure and cultural heritage.


Montara Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton is part of Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest-loyalty program for Hilton's distinct hotel brands. Members who book directly have access to instant benefits, including a flexible payment slider that allows members to choose nearly any combination of Points and money to book a stay, an exclusive member discount, free standard Wi-Fi and the Hilton Honors mobile app.


Tapestry Collection by Hilton is part of Hilton's Lifestyle portfolio, including other Collections brands like Curio Collection by Hilton and Outset Collection by Hilton. Together, these brands provide travelers with a diverse range of distinctive stays across the globe, each reflecting the character of its destination while backed by Hilton's renowned hospitality. Montara Hotel joins a growing collection of independently spirited properties that celebrate local culture, design and storytelling, offering an authentic Costa Rican experience with the benefits of Hilton's global network.


The debut of Montara Hotel reflects Hilton's continued expansion across the Caribbean and Latin America, where the company operates 315 hotels and resorts across more than 35 countries and territories and maintains a robust pipeline of 150 properties in development.


For more information or to make reservations, visit[Montara Hotel](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/syqmhup-montara-hotel/) .


##### FAQ: Montara Hotel Opens As the First Tapestry Collection by Hilton in Central America


Montara Hotel is a 97-room hotel that has opened as part of Tapestry Collection by Hilton, marking the lifestyle brand’s debut in Costa Rica and Central America. The hotel is designed around meaningful connections with nature and local culture, wellness and wellbeing, and experiences that allow travelers to slow down, disconnect and return home feeling better.


Montara Hotel is located in the mountains of Heredia, Costa Rica, approximately 13 miles (20 kilometers) from Juan Santamaria International Airport and downtown San Jose. The property overlooks the Central Valley and is near attractions including Braulio Carrillo National Park, Poas Volcano and La Paz Waterfall Gardens.


Montara Hotel opened on September 24, 2026, when Hilton announced the opening of the property as part of Tapestry Collection by Hilton.


The opening is significant because it marks the debut of Tapestry Collection by Hilton in both Costa Rica and Central America. It also reflects growing traveler demand for hotels that offer a strong sense of place, meaningful connections to local communities and experiences focused on wellness and wellbeing.


Montara Hotel is designed for travelers seeking meaningful connections with nature and local culture, prioritizing wellness and wellbeing, and choosing experiences that allow them to slow down, disconnect and return home feeling better. The property also serves guests exploring Costa Rica as well as groups hosting corporate retreats, social events, celebrations and weddings.
